# Market Integrity Policy — TEMPLATE

## Prohibited conduct

The project and any party acting on its behalf (team members, market makers, liquidity providers, affiliates) will not:

- Engage in wash trading or self-trading designed to inflate volume
- Place or cancel orders to create a false impression of demand (spoofing/layering)
- Coordinate trading activity without public disclosure of the arrangement
- Make misleading statements about price performance, volume, holder count, or adoption
- Use undisclosed paid promotion that could be mistaken for organic coverage

## Current known facts requiring honest disclosure (see `docs/MARKET_DATA_SNAPSHOT.md`)

- Market cap and liquidity are currently very low ($30 market cap, ~$20–30 in AMM liquidity as of 2026-09-21). Any public statement about "market potential" must not contradict this.
- No recent trading activity was observed at snapshot time.
- Holder concentration is high (top 5 wallets ≈ 84% of supply). Any statement implying broad distribution must be qualified against this.
